questions.q:
In a certain code language, 'BRAVE' is written as 'AQBUF' and 'DREAM' is written as 'CQFBL'. How will 'GRAPE' be written in that language?

एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, 'BRAVE' को 'AQBUF' और 'DREAM' को 'CQFBL' के रूप में लिखा जाता है। समान भाषा में 'GRAPE' को किस प्रकार लिखा जाएगा?
questions.s:
According to the alphabetical series, the consonants are replaced by the previous letter, and the vowels are replaced immediately after.

B ----- B - 1 = A

R ----- R - 1 = Q

A ----- A + 1 = B

V ----- V - 1 = U

E ----- E + 1 = F

D ----- D - 1 = C

R ----- R - 1 = Q

E ----- E + 1 = F

A ----- A + 1 = B

M ----- M - 1 = L

So,

G ----- G - 1 = F

R ----- R - 1 = Q

A ----- A + 1 = B

P ----- P - 1 = O

E ----- E + 1 = F

So, 'GRAPE' will be written in that language as 'FQBOF'.

E ----- E + 1 = F

So, 'GRAPE' will be written in that language as 'FQBOF'.

questions_hin.q_hi:
In a coded language, "he is also known" is coded as "BMGV", "in shop also" is coded as "KDB" and "he will shop" is coded as "KGO". Code for which word can't be determined?

एक कोडित भाषा में, " he is also known " को "BMGV "के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, " in shop also " को "KDB" के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है और "he will shop " को " KGO" के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। किस शब्द के लिए कोड निर्धारित नहीं किया जा सकता है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
It is given that,

"he is also known" is coded as "BMGV".................(1)

"in shop also" is coded as "KDB"................(2)

"he will shop" is coded as "KGO"................(3)

From (1) and (2), also == B.

From (2) and (3), shop == K.

From (1) and (3), he == G.

From (2), in == D.

From (3), will == O.

Here, the code for the word 'known' is either M or V.
